claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Yamaha-branded black electronic keyboard/synth, but does not confirm quality, functionality, or suitability for children (no working test shown).

risks.risk: Unverified working condition (may not power on, no sound, dead keys, or non-functional buttons/sliders).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, speaker output (audible notes), and a quick test of several keys plus at least 2–3 buttons/sliders on the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as not fully working/untested until a power-on and sound test is shown.

risks.risk: Model number unknown; wrong model can change value significantly (features, number of keys, built-in sounds, connectivity).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number on the keyboard (typically on the front panel or underside label) and the serial label.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for an unspecified Yamaha keyboard with unknown specs.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter/cord, sustain pedal, stand, cables) or battery compartment issues (if applicable).
risks.proof: Photos showing included items laid out (adapter/cord, pedal, stand/cables) plus a close-up of the battery compartment/ports if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if key accessories are missing (or adapter not included) until confirmed.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (key wear, scratches/dents, missing knobs/buttons, repairs) not fully captured by the shown angles.
risks.proof: Top-down and close-up shots of the full keybed (including both ends), plus close-ups of the control panel for missing/damaged knobs/buttons and any repair marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for moderate wear/possible cosmetic damage until close-ups confirm otherwise.

risks.risk: Potential scam/overstatement risk: seller claims 'good' but no evidence of testing; could be non-working or incomplete.
risks.proof: Same as working-condition proof: power-on + audible test + demonstration that key controls respond.
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively as untested/possibly faulty to protect against overstatement.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Yamaha model number and serial label (front panel and/or underside).
Video: power-on and audible sound test across several keys (including both low and high ends).
Video: demonstrate at least 2–3 buttons/sliders/controls responding (e.g., change sound/volume/effects).
Photos of what’s included: power adapter/cord, sustain pedal, stand, and any cables; show battery compartment/ports if applicable.
Close-up photos of the entire keybed and control panel showing any missing/damaged knobs/buttons and overall wear.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a Yamaha electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at its worst-case for an untested/unknown-model unit; the seller’s 'good for children' claim is not verifiable from the report.
